query:
SELECT t.number AS "number!: i64", t.title,
                  COALESCE(
                      (SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e
                       WHERE e.task_id = t.number AND e.type = 'task.status_changed'),
                      t.created_at
                  ) AS "since!: i64"
           FROM tasks t
           WHERE t.kind = 'human' AND t.status = 'todo' AND t.archived_at IS NULL
           ORDER BY 3, t.number
